# Appchi task map

Candidate reading plan only: matching does not establish completeness. Read applicable workspace/repository instructions, inspect actual callers and source indexes, resolve scope corrections, and expand when new dependencies or uncertainty appear. Stop initial exploration only when behavior, constraints, affected boundaries and verification are clear.

Required links are mandatory reading dependencies. Conditional links identify when to expand; they are not automatically selected.

Open the workspace root as an Obsidian vault to include sibling repositories. Use a route's local graph for a focused neighborhood; graph edges alone do not encode the conditions below.

| Route | Applies when |
|---|---|
| [Behavior and system boundaries](routes/behavior.md) | The requested change affects observable behavior, architecture or repository boundaries. |
| [Shared commands and transactions](routes/shared-commands.md) | Adding or changing product mutations, request validation, retries or expected-revision handling. |
| [Incident feature baseline](routes/incidents.md) | Adding or changing incident content, lifecycle, assignment, membership, list or detail behavior. |
| [Incident mutations and lifecycle](routes/incident-mutations.md) | Changing incident notes, content, assignment, state transitions or command results. |
| [Incident membership and ownership](routes/incident-membership.md) | Changing linking, unlinking, moving alerts, active ownership, or resolve/reopen ownership effects. |
| [Incident collection and search](routes/incident-search.md) | Changing incident search, filtering, ordering, cursor semantics or list counts. |
| [Correlation evaluation and rule management](routes/correlation.md) | Changing automatic incident creation or attachment, evidence, ordering, rules, or rule tests. |
| [Maintenance qualification and management](routes/maintenance.md) | Changing maintenance windows, matching, overlap, suppression, timezones or release behavior. |
| [UI appearance without behavior changes](routes/ui-appearance.md) | Changing visual spacing, typography, color, layout or styling while preserving interaction and contracts. |
| [UI interaction and browser behavior](routes/ui-behavior.md) | Changing navigation, forms, loading/error states, accessibility behavior or browser state. |
| [Native and Kafka event contracts](routes/event-contract.md) | Changing native input or Kafka event fields, semantics, serialization or compatibility. |
| [HTTP contracts and generated clients](routes/http-contract.md) | Changing Product API or Ingestion API endpoints, request/response envelopes, or generated client types. |
| [PostgreSQL schema, privileges and migrations](routes/database.md) | Changing tables, columns, indexes, RLS, SQL privileges or migration execution. |
| [Identity, sessions, grants and authorization](routes/identity-access.md) | Changing authentication, tenant access, grants, identity publication or assignee eligibility. |
| [Live publishing, SSE and reconciliation](routes/live-updates.md) | Changing API live publishing, SSE streams, reconnect, polling, scoped invalidation or render proof. |
| [Alert CEL, search projection and visibility](routes/search.md) | Changing CEL semantics, alert search/counts, Elasticsearch projection, reconciliation or rebuild. |
| [Deployment, qualification and coordinated rollout](routes/delivery.md) | Preparing a release, changing workloads or assessing capability readiness and rollout compatibility. |
| [Packages, locks and workspace compatibility](routes/dependencies.md) | Changing packages, lock files, internal revision pins or coordinated editable environments. |
| [Documentation and instruction maintenance](routes/documentation.md) | Changing instructions, navigation, task routes, document links or explanatory prose without changing product requirements. |
| [Alert lifecycle and manual operations](routes/alerts.md) | Changing alert assignment, notes, lifecycle, suppression controls, history or bulk manual operations. |
| [Operator keys, Kong and Grafana provisioning](routes/operators.md) | Changing operator lifecycle, keys, synchronous provisioning or shared Grafana routing. |
| [Shared presets and dashboards](routes/shared-views.md) | Changing saved presets, dashboard definitions, count batches, shared editing or references. |
| [Recovery fences, replay and retained history](routes/recovery.md) | Changing restore safety, retirement helpers, protected proof, replay fences or history access. |
